xsk3_area_closing — 2D morphology op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "xsk3_area_closing", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

*The 4th column is a colour (H,W,3) input. This op handles colour without crossing channels (it does not convolve the colour channel as a third spatial axis).*

Usage

Area closing (skimage `morphology.area_closing`). A size-based morphological operation that fills in only dark regions (dips) with area below a threshold - unlike ordinary closing, it selects targets by the area of the connected component rather than the shape of the structuring element.

`a は面積閾値(int(16+a*100) で 16〜116 画素)を振る。b` は未使用。
